inputs.label: Findings draft
inputs.content:
Results we have:
R1: our urban heat model reaches 2.1 C mean absolute error vs 2.9 C for the
    interpolation baseline, on one city, one summer, one run.

Findings:
F1: the model is more accurate than interpolation on this city.
F2: the model trains faster than interpolation.
F3: the model is more robust to sensor outages.
F4: the model reduces sensor deployment cost.

We did not measure training time, sensor outages, or deployment cost.
